xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Demand notice received by Multi Commodity Exchange Clearing Corporation Limited (MCXCCL), wholly owned subsidiary of the company from GST- CBIC, Gujarat for an amount of Rs. 19,476/- with penalty Rs. 20,000/- for the F.Y.: 2021-2022
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: The demand notice is issued against a claim of Input Tax Credit (ITC) of Rs. 19,476/- was in the financial year 2021-22. The demand notice is issued on the ground of excess claim of ITC as it is stated that the accommodation services might have been availed by guests rather than employees of the company, which is not allowed for ITC claim.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: For MCXCCL and MCX, there is no impact on operations or other activities of the company arising out of the demand notice. The financial impact to the extent of demand notice.
